tickets.title: Add configuration and SQLite notification state
requirements: Load and validate NTFY_TOPIC, MIN_PRICE_EUR, MAX_PRICE_EUR, MAX_DISTANCE_KM, and STATE_DB_PATH with PRD defaults.
Create and reuse SQLite notification state without silently resetting corrupt databases.
Read notified IDs and persist new IDs transactionally and idempotently.
Ignore local environment, SQLite, cache, and macOS metadata files.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration defaults, overrides, and invalid values are unit tested.
Schema creation, reopened persistence, idempotency, and corrupt database failure are unit tested.

tickets.title: Implement strict listing classification, distance, and ranking
requirements: Normalize listing text and strictly require PS5, Slim, and disc-edition identity.
Reject digital-only, accessory, game-only, wanted, repair, damaged, and parts listings.
Apply active-status, EUR, price, approximate Haversine distance, notified-ID, and deterministic ranking rules.
acceptance_criteria: Positive wording and all rejection categories are unit tested.
Price and distance boundaries are unit tested.
Malformed data, duplicate exclusion, and deterministic ordering are unit tested.

tickets.title: Add the anonymous OLX GraphQL client and response parser
requirements: Send the verified minimal anonymous GraphQL request with explicit timeout and no credentials.
Request at most 40 newest matching listings with the verified search parameters and minimal selection set.
Validate the full response envelope and fail closed on transport or GraphQL errors.
Parse typed listing fields while skipping malformed individual items with warnings.
acceptance_criteria: A representative successful response is parsed in unit tests.
Tests assert the request has no authorization, cookies, or seller/contact fields.
All transport and response-envelope failures are unit tested.
The complete unittest suite passes without live network access.

tickets.title: Add ntfy delivery, one-shot orchestration, and server instructions
requirements: Publish one ntfy message with at most three ranked deals and one view action per deal.
Remain silent when no unseen match exists and persist IDs only after successful publication.
Implement stdout, stderr, and process exit behavior for all completed and failed checks.
Document installation, configuration, testing, one-shot execution, state, privacy, and non-overlapping server scheduling.
acceptance_criteria: Payload, no-match, all-notified, excess-match, first-run, and failure flows are unit tested.
Tests prove state changes only after successful publication.
CLI exit behavior is tested without live network access.
README instructions cover installation through scheduled operation.
